newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks marginally firmer by early morning.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks marginally firmer by early morning.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were marginally firmer on Monday morning, opening higher after falling by more than two percent on Friday, brokers said.
They said however, that there were few fresh factors to fuel buying and gains were likely to be limited.
As of 0021 GMT, the Nikkei average was 35.00 points or 0.18 percent higher at 19,839.38. Its September futures were up 50 at 19,850.
"Stocks slumped amid thin trade last week and any recovery may be limited as Mondays are usually slow," a trader at a "Big Four" brokerage said.
